title: The Winnings
subtitle: Rolled when you collect, and it can come up empty
description: The reward is a `tasked:loot` -- a roll of `reward_tables/loot.json`
taken the moment you press Claim. The table's `emptyWeight` is 3 against
9 of weight, so one roll in four is nothing at all, and that is a property
of the file rather than a bug: a `loot` reward is the kind that can
The weight-zero entry is not part of that gamble. Zero means always
granted, once per roll, so the five experience points arrive every time --
it is how a table says "and everyone also gets this".
